name: Adamawa
description: A high plateau region straddling the boundary between Cameroon's forested south and savanna north, known for cool climate, rolling hills, and cattle herding.
funFact: Adamawa is nicknamed the 'water tower of Cameroon' because many of the country's major rivers originate on its plateau.

name: Centre
description: Home to Yaoundé, Cameroon's political capital, built across seven hills and surrounded by dense forest.
funFact: Yaoundé is often called the 'city of seven hills' due to its distinctive hilly terrain.

name: East
description: Cameroon's largest region by area, covered mostly by dense equatorial rainforest and home to indigenous Baka communities.
funFact: The East region contains the Dja Faunal Reserve, a UNESCO World Heritage Site almost untouched by human activity.

name: Far North
description: Cameroon's hottest and driest region, marked by the rugged Mandara Mountains and Sahelian savanna landscapes.
funFact: The Far North is home to the Kapsiki people and the dramatic volcanic spires of the Rhumsiki area.

name: Littoral
description: Cameroon's smallest region by area but its economic powerhouse, home to Douala, the country's largest city and main port.
funFact: Despite its small size, Littoral has the highest population density of any Cameroonian region.

name: North
description: A vast savanna region along the Benoue River, known for cotton farming, cattle, and protected wildlife areas.
funFact: The North region hosts Benoue National Park, one of Cameroon's most important wildlife reserves.

name: Northwest
description: An English-speaking highland region famous for its grassfields kingdoms, cool climate, and scenic mountain roads.
funFact: The Northwest is home to the Bamenda Ring Road, a scenic 367 km loop through highland villages and volcanic lakes.

name: South
description: A lush, sparsely populated equatorial forest region along the Atlantic coast, bordering Gabon and Equatorial Guinea.
funFact: The South region's Lobé Falls is one of the very few waterfalls in the world that flows directly into the ocean.

name: Southwest
description: An English-speaking coastal region dominated by Mount Cameroon, the highest peak in West Africa.
funFact: Mount Cameroon is an active volcano and the highest point in West Africa at 4,040 m.

name: West
description: A densely populated highland region home to the Bamileke people, known for its many traditional royal chiefdoms.
funFact: The West region has one of the highest concentrations of traditional royal palaces in Cameroon.
